# Allotment tasks

A task is a list line that starts with a checkbox. The note is the task list, in line order.

## This week

- [/] Dig compost into bed 3 #allotment/beds
- [ ] Sow a row of salad leaves in bed 4
- [ ] Order fleece before the first frost, see [[Allotment plan#The fruit corner]]
- [x] Test the soil, written up in [[Soil test]]
- [-] Build a second compost bin

## The four statuses

| Write | Status |
|---|---|
| `- [ ]` | todo |
| `- [/]` | doing |
| `- [x]` | done |
| `- [-]` | cancelled |

## Nested tasks

- [/] Get bed 2 ready
    - [x] Clear the weeds
    - [/] Rake it level
    - [ ] Lay the carrot fly cover
- [ ] Mend the water butt
    - [ ] Buy a new tap
    - [-] Borrow a drill

## In a callout

> [!todo] Site jobs
> - [ ] Ask the site secretary about the hedge
> - [x] Pay the plot rent

Tasks are read-only in the browser. To change one, edit its character in the note.
